subject: literacy
concept: Synthesizing primary textual evidence with secondary source support into an outline
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a full outline placing primary evidence and secondary source support under each supporting point
exercise.abstract: Student creates a detailed thesis outline integrating both primary textual evidence and secondary critical support

assessment.mastery_threshold: outline includes at least two supporting points, each with both primary and secondary evidence
misconception_flags: outline relies entirely on secondary sources without any primary textual evidence, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
